# Saapasá Café

> Cozy café & kitchen in Whitefield, Bengaluru — "where every flavour hits the right note."

## Key facts
- Address: Ground Floor, SLN Complex, Vijayanagar Main Rd, opposite NVT Life Square, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 84990 36816
- Hours: open daily, breakfast onwards until 10:30 PM
- Rating: 4.7★ on Google
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/saapasa_cafe/
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/MykhM6MiEktZDTkL8
- Coordinates: 12.97494, 77.76494

## What we serve
Specialty coffee (espresso, cappuccino, latte, affogato, hot chocolate; oat milk available), frappes & thick shakes (Biscoff, java chip, Ferrero), whole-wheat breakfast (pancakes, French toast, avocado toast), smoothie bowls & cold-pressed juices, in-house focaccia sandwiches, short eats (peri peri fries, nachos, garlic bread), durum-wheat pastas (aglio e olio, pesto, arrabbiata, alfredo, pink sauce), hand-tossed pizzas (margherita, paneer tikka, farmhouse, rustic mushroom), rice bowls (Mexican, Thai curries, Andhra avakaya / muddha pappu / gongura specials), mocktails, and desserts (brownies, blueberry cheesecake, Lotus Biscoff, tiramisu, Turkish kunafa). Prices roughly ₹99–₹399.

## Vibe
Warm plaster walls with backlit arches and dried wheat, cane furniture, a book corner and board games — an aesthetic, cozy space in Whitefield for breakfast, work-from-café days, dates and small parties.
